description: This file defines an abstract class 'MemoryManagerSyncOps' that manages synchronization operations for an in-memory database, including schema management, file indexing, session handling, and fallback mechanisms within a larger system. It includes methods for ensuring vector extension readiness, database operations, session delta processing, and reindexing workflows.

classes.name: MemoryManagerSyncOps
classes.description: An abstract class providing synchronization operations for managing memory index data, including database schema management, file indexing, session delta processing, and fallback provider activation within a larger system.

methods.name: openMemoryDatabaseAtPath
methods.description: Opens or creates a SQLite database at the specified path with optional extension allowance.

methods.name: shouldIgnoreMemoryWatchPath
methods.description: Determines if a given path should be ignored based on predefined directory names.

methods.name: runDetachedMemorySync
methods.description: Runs a synchronization function asynchronously, catching and logging errors.

methods.name: ensureVectorReady
methods.description: Ensures the vector extension is loaded and ready, optionally setting up the vector table.

methods.name: loadVectorExtension
methods.description: Loads the SQLite vector extension if not already loaded.

methods.name: ensureVectorTable
methods.description: Creates the vector table in the database with specified dimensions.

methods.name: dropVectorTable
methods.description: Drops the vector table from the database.

methods.name: buildSourceFilter
methods.description: Builds SQL filter clause for specified data sources.

methods.name: openDatabase
methods.description: Opens the database at the configured path.

methods.name: seedEmbeddingCache
methods.description: Seeds the embedding cache table from a source database.

methods.name: swapIndexFiles
methods.description: Atomically swaps index files with a backup mechanism.

methods.name: moveIndexFiles
methods.description: Moves index files with specific suffixes.

methods.name: removeIndexFiles
methods.description: Removes index files with specific suffixes.

methods.name: ensureSchema
methods.description: Ensures the database schema is set up correctly, including FTS and vector tables.

methods.name: ensureWatcher
methods.description: Sets up file system watchers for memory files and multimodal content.

methods.name: ensureSessionListener
methods.description: Sets up session transcript update listener.

methods.name: scheduleSessionDirty
methods.description: Schedules session files for delta processing.

methods.name: processSessionDeltaBatch
methods.description: Processes batched session file deltas for indexing.

methods.name: updateSessionDelta
methods.description: Updates delta state for a session file based on size changes.

methods.name: countNewlines
methods.description: Counts newline characters in a file between specified byte offsets.

methods.name: resetSessionDelta
methods.description: Resets delta state for a session file.

methods.name: isSessionFileForAgent
methods.description: Checks if a session file belongs to the current agent.

methods.name: normalizeTargetSessionFiles
methods.description: Normalizes and filters session file paths for targeting.

methods.name: clearSyncedSessionFiles
methods.description: Clears or updates the set of session files marked for synchronization.

methods.name: ensureIntervalSync
methods.description: Sets up periodic sync based on configured interval.

methods.name: scheduleWatchSync
methods.description: Schedules a sync triggered by file system watch events.

methods.name: shouldSyncSessions
methods.description: Determines if session files should be synchronized based on parameters.

methods.name: syncMemoryFiles
methods.description: Synchronizes memory files, indexing new or changed files.

methods.name: syncSessionFiles
methods.description: Synchronizes session transcript files, indexing new or changed files.

methods.name: createSyncProgress
methods.description: Creates a progress tracker for sync operations.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Performs a full synchronization cycle, including vector extension loading, metadata management, and reindexing if needed.

methods.name: shouldFallbackOnError
methods.description: Determines if fallback provider activation should occur based on error message.

methods.name: resolveBatchConfig
methods.description: Resolves configuration for remote batching of embedding requests.

methods.name: activateFallbackProvider
methods.description: Activates a fallback embedding provider if configured and applicable.

methods.name: runSafeReindex
methods.description: Performs a safe reindexing process with temporary database swapping.

methods.name: runUnsafeReindex
methods.description: Performs an unsafe reindexing process without atomic file swapping, mainly for testing.

methods.name: resetIndex
methods.description: Resets the index by clearing database tables and dropping vector/FTS tables.

methods.name: readMeta
methods.description: Reads index metadata from the database.

methods.name: writeMeta
methods.description: Writes index metadata to the database.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredSourcesForMeta
methods.description: Resolves the sources to be stored in metadata.

methods.name: normalizeMetaSources
methods.description: Normalizes sources stored in metadata for comparison.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredScopeHash
methods.description: Computes a hash representing the current scope configuration.

methods.name: metaSourcesDiffer
methods.description: Checks if stored metadata sources differ from current configuration.
